description: The WorkOS callback sets the Envoi session and CSRF cookies and clears the flow cookie and the three old names.

set-cookie: envoi_session=PLACEHOLDER; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure; Max-Age=86400
envoi_workos_flow=; Path=/api/auth/workos; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure; Max-Age=0
sinaloa_session=; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure; Max-Age=0
sinaloa_workos_flow=; Path=/api/auth/workos; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure; Max-Age=0

client.next: Follow the redirect; the browser now holds only envoi_* cookies.
